changes: run-all-smokes.ts: extracted runEntrySet() shared worker-pool driver; runAllSmokes() now does pass1 (default jobs) → collect TIMEOUTs (minus noRetry entries) → pass2 (--jobs 1 serial) → merge (pass2 replaces pass1 for same name) → retried flag. Added --no-retry CLI flag + noRetry manifest field + conditional 'Final:' closing label. run-all-smokes-smoke.ts: +4 fixture cases (lock-file flaky dance + always-timeout) proving retry/noRetry/--no-retry/fail-both. smoke-manifest.json: +_schemaNote_noRetry annotation. CHANGELOG + docs/dev/test-coverage.md two-pass section.
usage: npm run test:all now self-heals parallel-load race timeouts: pass 1 runs high-concurrency; any TIMEOUT is retried serially in pass 2; output gains 'Pass 1:'/'Pass 2:'/'Final:' lines only when retry fires. npm run test:all -- --no-retry for CI strict (single-pass). noRetry:true in a manifest entry opts a smoke out of retry.
expectedOutcome: 3 consecutive npm run test:all all exit 0 with a full-pass summary; self-smoke 13/13; --no-retry produces pre-B-2941 single-pass output; production source + package.json untouched.
actualTranscript: 3x test:all all exit 0 (171/171 in 165.5s / 156.4s / 167.5s — pass 1 clean this round, no retry needed). self-smoke 13/13 incl 4 new retry cases. 3 reviewer lanes PASS (behavior R2, quality R1, test-coverage R2). 3 findings F-001/F-002/F-003 resolved (CHK-003:edge:0 intent rewritten from stale Final:167 to count-agnostic 3x-full-pass; userSees clarity noted in CHANGELOG/docs). Degraded 3x1 escalation cleared. Delivery PASS 5/5.
outcomeDiff: No difference vs goal: test:all is now a deterministic CI gate. The two-pass safety net is proven by self-smoke cases a/d even though the 3 live runs happened to have a clean pass 1 (no live timeout this round).
limitations: Retry masks parallel-load timeouts rather than fixing the underlying shared-state races (acceptable — every smoke passes serial; 0 real bugs concealed). A smoke that fails BOTH passes counts as a real Final FAIL (correct). Authority/production receipts NOT issued (degraded 3x1 fallback; authorityDone/productionDone stay false).
pitfalls: (1) PLAN-time intent 'Final: 167/167' was doubly stale by REVIEW: count grew to 171 AND the Final: prefix only appears when retry fires (pass 1 was clean in the live runs). Lesson: for two-pass-style features, assert the INVARIANT (3x exit 0, count-agnostic) not a specific output-state string. (2) userSees is PLAN-frozen — can't fix conflated acceptance text in DEV; the accurate description had to live in CHANGELOG/docs instead. (3) self-smoke must PROVE the retry path with deterministic fixtures (lock-file dance) since live runs may not organically produce a timeout.
